content.text:
happy sunday, and the first official day of summer.

juno's 4-year checkup is coming up in about three weeks — a good moment to loop in your pediatric office and get that on the calendar before summer gets away from you. nothing urgent, just a routine visit that's easier to book early than to chase down in august. wren's part of the mix today too, of course — hope they're sleeping in.

nothing new popped up locally this week, so no village suggestion to weigh in on. the one easy next step: a quick call or portal message to your pediatrician to lock in juno's appointment.
